Sagar Rajendra Kharpatil vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr
on 16 April, 2024

Author: M. S. Karnik
Bench: M. S. Karnik
Urmila Ingale 30-apeal-496-21.doc
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal No. 496 Of 2021
Sagar Rajendra Kharpatil .. Appellant
 Vs.
The State Of MAHARASHTRa And Anr. ..Respondents

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. A.P. Mundargi i/b Mr. Subir Sarkar, for the appellant.
Mr. Shailesh Kharat, for respondent no.2.
Mr. S. H. Yadav, App for the State.
Psi- Mr. S.V. Sable, Uran police station present.
Coram : M. S. Karnik, J.
Date : April 16, 2024 P.C. :

1. Heard learned senior advocate for the appellant, learned counsel for the respondent no.2 and learned APP for the State.
2.

This is an appeal for quashing and setting aside impugned order dated 07/06/2021 passed by the Sessions Judge rejecting the anticipatory bail application of the appellant in respect of the offence punishable under sections 376, 377, 354, 504, 509,
323 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code ("IPC", for short), under section 3(1)(j) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 registered on 15/03/2021 vide C.R. Urmila Ingale 30-apeal-496-21.doc No.76 of 2021 with Uran police station.

entities.text: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. The trial Court recorded a finding that prima facie, there are no abuses in the name of caste.
There is matrimonial dispute between the parties.
Learned senior advocate submitted that the notice for divorce is issued on 17/03/2020 and the present FIR came to be lodged on 15/03/2021.
It is the submission of learned senior advocate that only after notice for divorce was issued that the complaint came to be filed.

It is Sagar Rajendra Kharpatil vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50270100/
1 the submission that prior to the lodging of the present FIR, respondent no.2 had lodged one FIR under section 498A of IPC against the applicant-husband and others on 04/03/2021.

entities.text: Sagar Rajendra Kharpatil vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is the submission that in the said complaint dated 04/03/2021,
there is no whisper of any of the allegations made in the present FIR dated 15/03/2021.
4.
The appeal is opposed by learned APP as well as learned counsel for the respondent no.2.
Learned APP submitted that the applicant is not co-operating with the investigation.

Learned senior advocate for the appellant submitted that the appellant is willing to join the investigation and co-operate with the investigation and that Urmila Ingale 30-apeal-496-21.doc he is willing to hand over mobile phone to the investigating officer if so called upon by the investigating officer.
Statement is accepted.
5. Let the appellant report to the investigating officer.

The appellant to report to the investigating officer of Uran police station on 22/04/2024 and 23/04/2024 between 10.00 a.m. and 1.00 p.m..
and co-operate with the investigation.
6. In the meantime, the appellant needs to be protected by an interim order.

7. In the event of arrest in connection with C.R.No. 76 of 2021 dated 15/03/2021 registered with Uran police station, the appellant-Sagar Rajendra Kharpatil shall be released on bail on furnishing P.R. bond to the extent of Rs.15,000/- with one or more sureties of the like amount.
8. The appellant to co-operate with the investigation.

9. Stand over to 25/04/2024.
(M. S. KARNIK, J.) Signed by: Urmila P. Ingale Designation: PS To Honourable Judge Date:
